parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the paginated results Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of results per page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description:
The query conditions. Specify the value of this parameter as a string in the JSON format.

>  The results vary based on the query condition. For more information, see the "**Query parameters**" section in this topic.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: The Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resources --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --query product_:_waf --tag Value=TagValue1 Key=Tagkey1 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeDefenseResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --Tag.1.Key Tagkey1 --PageSize 10 --Query 'product_:_waf' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TagValue1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
